${open?`
${firstStyle?firstPrompt:`
${styleBadge(p.style)}${button('Change Style','style',`data-id="${e(c.id)}"`,'ghost compact')}
${success?'Your Dialed In Window':'Starting Recommendation'}
${recipeGrid(rec,v.advanced.temperature,v.tempUnit)}${button(`${icon('plus',16)} Log A Shot`,'log',`data-id="${e(c.id)}"`,'primary full log-cta')}`}${rec.reasons?.length?`

${e(rec.reasons[0])}

`:''}${last&&(!success||this.justSavedId===last.id)?`
${advice.next?'Next Shot Recommendation':'Shot Feedback'}${advice.next?``:''}

${e(nextShotTitle(advice))}

${nextShotGuidance(advice,last,v.advanced.temperature,v.tempUnit)}${advice.next?`

${e(NEXT_SHOT_INFO)}

`:''}${chips(last.tasteScales)}${radar(last.tasteScales)}
`:''}
Coffee Details
${[['Roaster',c.roaster],['Origin',c.origin],['Elevation',c.elevationM],['Roast Level',c.roastLevel],['Process',c.process],...(c.isDecaf&&c.decaffeinationMethod?[['Decaffeination Method',c.decaffeinationMethod]]:[]),['Variety',c.variety],['Producer',c.producer],['Tasting Notes',c.tastingNotes]].filter(x=>x[1]).map(([k,val])=>`
${e(k)}
${e(val)}
`).join('')}

${c.status==='verified'?'Approved coffee':'Pending approval · your shots stay private.'}

${button('Edit Coffee Details','edit-coffee',`data-id="${e(c.id)}"`,'ghost compact')}${c.status==='pending'?button('Check For A Verified Match','check-pending-match',`data-id="${e(c.id)}"`,'ghost compact'):''}${c.status==='pending'?button('Retry Automatic Approval','retry-member-auto-approval',`data-id="${e(c.id)}"`,'ghost compact'):''}${c.status==='pending'&&this.raw?.submissions?.find(sub=>sub.id===this.raw?.library?.find(l=>l.id===c.id)?.submission_id)?.source_url?button('Retry Official Source Check','retry-pending-source',`data-id="${e(c.id)}"`,'ghost compact'):''}${this.raw?.submissions?.some(sub=>sub.canonical_coffee_id&&sub.status==='pending'&&sub.canonical_coffee_id===this.raw?.library?.find(l=>l.id===c.id)?.coffee_id)?'

Correction pending review. The shared coffee record is unchanged.

':''}
Shot History (${shots.length})${shots.length?`
${button(shots.every(sh=>this.shotExpanded.has(sh.id))?'Collapse All':'Expand All','shot-toggle-all',`data-id="${e(c.id)}"`,'text-button')}
`:''}${shots.map(sh=>shotCard(sh,{expanded:this.shotExpanded.has(sh.id),activeVersionId:v.id,unit:v.tempUnit})).join('')}
`:''}
`;
